notes.title: UPDATE 20/05/2025
notes.notes:
Another day, another 2 builds deployed. And very soon those of you in the Playtest will find these release notes practically useful! We are now focused just on the localisation and the UI improvements. 

The first users getting invited to the Playtest will be from the regions where we have the languages ready: Japan, Russia/Ukraine, China/HK, and the US. In the next wave, we'll add more languages and invite more players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/011a6223611a04ab01207166766501e51b4e3cda.jpg[/img]

Changes up to version 406 –

[h3][b]VISUALS[/b][/h3]

[*]VFX for environment effects are in, with the first entry: Toxic Fog in "The Metamorphosis".
[*]Nigh-time background is in, with the first entry: "Blackpwas & Splitjaws"
[*]Activated tokens now have a small-but-nice VFX playing over the frames, to highlight them.

[h3][b]USER INTERFACE[/b][/h3]

[*]A bunch of fixes and updates everywhere, mostly harmonization and better readablity.
[*]Token interaction window updated
[*]Fixed a bug with the icon that shows change of school on activation
[*]Fixed a bug with the token frames from Kaira's crystals, that change school when activated
[*]Now you cannot select any opponent creatures in the Resolution phase
[*]Immunity tooltip is updated
[*]Font size is synchronized across multiple windows
[*]Window that shows Deck and Discard Pile is now semitransparent
[*]Updated stamps on challenges that are locked or in production
[*]Updated Victory and Defeat screens

[h2][b]TEXTS[/b][/h2]

[*]Loads of edits for texts in EN, RU and JP

notes.title: UPDATE 06/05/2025
notes.notes:
As we get closer to opening the Playtest, we upgrade the weekly notes from "patch notes" to "regular updates" to make sure it won't be lost on those who participate in the test.

The current status:

* We have submitted the Playtest build for the pre-release review, and expect to pass it within a week or so (unless we run into some specific issue)

* We opened the sign-ups to the Playtest, and currently have a bit over 200 players in the list there (top countries: Russia, China, USA, Poland, Japan)

To join the Playtest, you need to hit the green button that says "Request access":

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451974/ad3adfe1d89043282ee4cb4dee0e7b93042f4477.jpg[/img]

It is so good to have this functionality, where we don't need to generate and distribute Steam keys on our own, and everything is automated! A huge progress since the times we ran the tests for our earlier projects.

And now, what's new in Tuesday's build –

[h3][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3]

[*]Updated tutorial:
[list]
[*]All the tutorial errors are fixed.
[*]There are still some situations when “END TURN“ button is not locked when is should be – we'll work on fixing this in the next update.
[*]The tutorial flow is now expanded to include more items.
[*]The UI is updated.
[*]The texts are still placeholder texts, and need editing/translation[/list]
[*]Removed unnecessary UI screens:
[list]
[*]"Victory" (a new one is coming)
[*]"Retreat" (not possible in the Playtest/Demo mode)
[*]"Questionnaire" (we used to have it, but now simply won't have the time to read the responses[/list]
[*]Added collection of data when crashes occur
[*]Improved balance in the challenges from the Bonus Book

As of now, we aim to release the Playtest with 2 books (Prologue and Bonus), which have 10 and 3 challenges respectively. This comes to 39 encounters between the two, unlockable through progression.

[h3][b]VISUALS[/b][/h3]
[*]New token visual – test version is in the build
[*]New token frames – still not happy, but we're getting there
[*]Updated logo in the Main Menu (dragon eyes changed)

[h3][b]MUSIC AND SOUNDS[/b][/h3]

[*]New SFX for Swamp Monster and its tentacle tokens
[*]New SFX for Stone Knife token

[h3][b]FIXES[/b][/h3]

[*]Fixed the bug that made the wrong music play in encounters

[h2][b]UI[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]CHALLENGES[/b][/h3]

[*]Updated book visuals
[*]Updated solution for how the blocked books look

[h3][b]ENCOUNTER[/b][/h3]

[*]Special effects now have a duration ("for how many rounds")
[*]Updated NEW ROUND announcement
[*]Updated HP bars for player and opponent parties
[*]Updated selection of character/creature via portrait in encounter
[*]Updated UI for Kaira's hand (crystals in hand)
[*]Updated round counter – still some work to do

[h3][b]MAIN MENU[/b][/h3]

[*]Updated Settings

[h2][b]STEAM[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]VISUAL ASSETS[/b][/h3]

[*]Updated library and store assets for the main app
[*]Updated library and store assets for the Playtest app
[*] added story trailer to the store page of the main app

notes.title: UPDATE 29/04/2025
notes.notes:
We have registered the game for the upcoming Next Fest, and are now on the last stretch of the UI overhaul, following which we'll run a Playtest (to see what we missed, before the public demo).

We don't know yet, if the Story mode will make it into the Fest or not. We start with the encounters, and the battle system, and then we'll see how much of a story we can unlock on top of this.

[h3][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3]
[*]Updated tutorial. Some parts are still work in progress:
[list]
[*]Added highlights to the elements we want to focus on.
[*]Most elements that should be locked (to avoid breaking the tutorial) are locked now. There are some situations when “END TURN“ button is still not locked, when is should be locked – to be fixed in the future.
[*]All the triggers are working.
[*]The tutorial has a temporary UI.
[*]The texts are temporary (placeholders).[/list]
[h3][b]VISUALS[/b][/h3]
[*]Animation of token activation is improved.
[*]Fluter's protection token is updated.
[*]New Swamp Monster tokens added (still work in progress).
[*]The look of tentacles of Swamp Monster are updated.
[*]The background in the Swamp Monster encounter is updated.
[*]Stoke Knife's tokens are updated (still work in progress).
[*]Additional updates for a number of tokens (still evolving):[list]
[*]Astral Fear Crystal token for the Leafclaw challenges
[*]Protection Damage Crystal token for the Leafclaw challenges
[*]Frost Acid Crystal token for the Leafclaw challenges
[*]Light Fire Crystal token for the Leafclaw challenges
[*]Tito's Damage token
[*]Blackpaw's Damage token
[*]Splitjaw's Damage token[/list]
[h2][b]UI[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]CHALLENGES[/b][/h3]
[*]New art illustration for every challenge
[*]New group portraits for bonus challenges
[*]Updated Challenge UI. Some parts are still work in progress:[list]
[*]Launch button is fixed
[*]“In development” filter is not there
[*]Marker for "all versions of this challenge are completed" is now present
[*]Some tags/tooltips might be off
[*]Texts are still placeholder[/list]
[h3][b]ENCOUNTER[/b][/h3]
[*]UI updated, still some work to do but we're getting there.

[h3][b]MAIN MENU[/b][/h3]
[*]Main menu updated:[list]
[*]Dev buttons are now hidden in the demo build
[*]Extra languages (not yet supported) are blocked[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 22/04/2025
notes.notes:
Second week, second set of release notes, can you believe it? We are getting there, my friends! This week we focused on the UI of the Challenge Mode, as this is what we intend to make publicly available in just a few weeks.

[h2][b]FEATURES[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]TUTORIAL[/b][/h3]
[*]We added the first version of a tutorial. Some parts are still WIP:
[list]
[*]No element highlights
[*]Other elements are not locked
[*]Missing some triggers, so some steps are shown one after another (not waiting for the action that player must do)
[*]Using the outdated UI for now
[*]All texts are placeholders[/list]

[h2][b]ENCOUNTERS[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]BALANCING[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed the balance of all star values, without the limitation of "maximum 5"[/list]

[h3][b]VISUALS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]New animation for when tokens enter the activated state[/list]

[h3][b]BUGFIXES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed error with unlocking the challenges on the Steam Playtest branch[/list]

[h2][b]USER EXPERIENCE[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]CHALLENGES[/b][/h3]
[*]Updated challenges UI. Some parts are still WIP:
[list]
[*]Launch button need a fix
[*]“In development” filter is not there
[*]Marker for "all sub-variants completed" is still not there
[*]Some tags/tooltips might be off
[*]No corresponding art
[*]Draft challenges descriptions[/list]

---

The goal for the next week's build is to be as close to the Challenges UI as we can, for the public Playtest, and then to shift our attention to checking the assets (VFX, SFX) for all the actual encounters, and to work on the Encounter UI itself (we have a new version that we like, on Figma, and now we need to move it to Unity).

notes.title: UPDATE 16/04/2025
notes.notes:
As we move closer to opening the first Steam Playtest, we decided to post here the release notes for the weekly builds since this is how we'll communicate the changes once the demo is live, anyways. So here's what's new this week –

[h2][b]ENCOUNTERS[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]BALANCING[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Rebalanced Prologue/Abandoned Mine encounter (Kaira's HP reduced; Kaira now gets Poison as a special effect, which kills her in a few rounds; player gets more stars out of this encounter)
[*]Rebalanced Prologue/Distorted Fluters (1) – to avoid the possibility for a token to level up in tutorial mode
[*]Rebalanced the number of stars earned in all the encounters in the Bonus Book
[*]Rebalanced Bonus Book/Stingtail (3) – there were issues with displaying the stingtail as the first creature, when there were multiple creatures in opposing party (WIP)
[/list]

[h3][b]VISUALS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Returned overlay layer shown over creatures which are not at the front of each party 
[*]Fixed positions for creatures in opposing parties 
[*]New assets for Swamp Monster (mini-boss) and the three different types of Swamp Monster's Tentacles
[*]Resized both types of Splitjaws
[*]Increased length of thread/rope holding Blackpaws in place
[/list]

[h3][b]BUGFIXES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Disabled ability to change party positions of player characters in Prologue/Distorted Fluters (2)
[/list]

[h2][b]USER EXPERIENCE[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]CHALLENGES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]UpdatedUI (WIP)
[*]When accessing Challenges menu, the first book (Prologue) is immediately open
[*]Added a marker that shows who has the initiative in encounter

[h3][b]WIN SCREEN[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]New assets for Swamp Monster and the three types of Swamp Monster's Tentacles
[*]New assets for Blackpaws, without thread (old assets were displayed incorrectly)
[/list]
